headings: # Zang Fu Organ Relationships: Interior-Exterior Pairings and Five Element Dynamics
nodes.summary: Zang Fu theory describes the functional organ systems of Traditional Chinese Medicine and their complex interrelationships. The five Zang solid organs store vital substances and the six Fu hollow organs transform and transport. Each Zang is paired with a Fu organ through interior-exterior meridian relationships sharing the same Five Element phase.
